# RFC-0002: Job scheduling

## Abstract

Builds on [[RFC-0001]] and touches the [[spec page]] for queues.

## Motivation

A bare RFC-0001 mention, and a bare Wings mention, are candidates for linking.
Neither `[[RFC-0001]]` in code nor this fence is:

```
[[RFC-0001]]
```

Already linked [RFC-0001](0001-queues.md) text must never be offered again, nor
must a [Wings](../spec/glossary.md#wings) that is already a link.

The queue is `wings`-shaped, and WINGS and wings name the same entry.

The `queue` runs [[RFC-0001]] jobs on one line holding code and a link.

## Proposal

RFC-0002 is this document's own identifier and is never suggested.

## Alternatives considered

None.

## Backwards compatibility

Nothing.
